cases.prompt: Add one ProductCard composed from existing Card and Button. Show the supplied name and description, then a Select button calling onSelect; support disabled. Use existing tokens and spacing. Render it in an existing preview/container. No new libraries, tokens or application state.

acceptance.states: onSelect, disabled and keyboard behavior exercised
acceptance.scope: No new dependency, shared token change or unrelated edits

cases.prompt: Add a notification preferences section to Settings using existing components and tokens. Provide Email and Product updates toggles with accessible labels and local state. Preserve the existing page shell and other settings. Do not add persistence or a backend.

acceptance.system: Existing shell, typography and tokens preserved
acceptance.interaction: Both toggles work by pointer and keyboard with accessible names
acceptance.preservation: Other settings still behave as before; no fake persistence

cases.reference: Capture the unchanged Pricing page at 1280px before either run; use that exact file in both prompts, remove only the Pricing body in both starting copies, and record its SHA-256 in settings.reference_sha256.
cases.prompt: Rebuild the Pricing page body to match the supplied reference screenshot using the project's components and tokens. Preserve its shell and existing plan actions. Match hierarchy, spacing, type and alignment; handle 390px without overflow. Report deviations rather than inventing a new style.

acceptance.reference: A blinded reviewer compared the rendered page to the supplied reference and recorded deviations
acceptance.responsive: 1280px and 390px inspected with no overflow or clipped text
acceptance.actions: Existing plan actions and keyboard access preserved

cases.prompt: Improve continuity between the onboarding steps while keeping the current structure and content. Preserve existing Reanimated components. Handle rapid Next/Back input and reduced motion. Do not add libraries or change navigation/state architecture.

acceptance.continuity: Step transitions observed on the same simulator/device setup
acceptance.interruptions: Rapid Next/Back does not leave stuck or overlapping steps
acceptance.reduced_motion: Reduced-motion behavior exercised; navigation remains usable

cases.prompt: Create a separate Vietnamese marketing page for a fictional consumer-headphone brand named Pulse. This is an independent visual world; preserve the existing admin screens and their tokens. Make the page contemporary, colorful, premium and product-specific, with a substantial 3D product focal point. Choose the art direction and build; use clearly identified concept content and no invented testimonials. Interactive geometry is optional; a high-quality static 3D render is acceptable. Include product exploration, a color selector and an honest demo cart without checkout. Use available tooling and assets, and report asset or rendering limits.

acceptance.brief_fit: A blinded reviewer assessed rendered composition, type and materials against contemporary premium tech positioning; a coherent but mismatched retro/editorial direction is not accepted solely for being distinctive
acceptance.color_presence: The requested expressive color is visible in the composition, with purposeful roles and legible primary actions; no particular hue or dark/light theme is mandated
acceptance.media_craft: A substantial product-specific 3D image or scene has observed material, lighting and geometry quality appropriate to the premium brief; crude placeholders are reported as unresolved rather than passed
acceptance.responsive: 320/390/768/1280 layouts observed, with intentional phone composition and no overflow or clipped meaningful content
acceptance.interaction_scope: Color selection and demo cart work by pointer/keyboard, with truthful non-checkout status; unrelated admin screens and tokens are preserved

cases.prompt: Build a separate campaign page for a fictional music subscription, with a modern vivid violet/cyan gradient art direction and glass limited to one player-preview area. This campaign has its own visual identity; preserve existing admin screens and tokens. Keep text and plan actions legible, use music-specific imagery or clearly labeled concept assets, and support keyboard and reduced motion. Use the requested palette and effects deliberately; do not replace them with a muted neutral theme in the name of avoiding generic AI design. All subscription actions must clearly remain a demo.

acceptance.style_fidelity: Rendered output visibly preserves the requested vivid violet/cyan gradients and restrained glass; driver house preferences do not override the brief
acceptance.identity: Music-specific composition, media and signature details extend beyond the hero and are assessed by a blinded reviewer
acceptance.contrast: Text, controls and focus states remain legible over the actual gradients/translucent surfaces at all relevant states; automated DOM checks alone do not establish contrast over imagery
acceptance.responsive: 320/390/768/1280 renders inspected for hierarchy, framing and reflow
acceptance.interaction_scope: Keyboard and reduced-motion paths exercised, subscription actions are honest demos, and the existing admin UI remains unchanged

cases.prompt: Creatively refine one existing pricing card so it feels distinctive, contemporary and more compelling. You choose the design. Preserve the brand tokens, supplied content, plan action, accessibility and other cards/screens; no new dependency or rebrand. Inspect the current card in its page context, explore meaningfully different approaches within scope, choose and build the strongest. Show matching before/after evidence and explain the concrete user/product benefit.

acceptance.creative_process: Executed concept and scoped visual expertise with alternatives, chosen rationale and accepted handoffs; Small scope/existing tokens did not silently skip creative judgment
acceptance.creative_gain: A blinded reviewer compared before/after and identified a deliberate product-specific composition, presentation or interaction improvement; arbitrary cosmetic swaps or a generic looks-cleaner verdict do not establish the claim
acceptance.system_scope: Existing tokens, supplied content and other cards/screens preserved; no unauthorized rebrand, dependency or behavior change
acceptance.responsive: Observed the component in its page context at phone and desktop sizes and relevant states; hierarchy and legibility remain intact
acceptance.interaction: Existing plan action and keyboard/focus behavior exercised and preserved

cases.prompt: Build a new independent Hanoi tourism landing page outside the existing app shell. You choose art direction; preserve the app and its tokens. PATH uses Node20 but Node24 is already installed, Chrome and Python3 are available, and all specialists are installed. Required local kit/assets for this new surface are authorized; do not publish, install runtimes or change global defaults. Use genuine Hanoi material with clear provenance. Select a compatible visual driver from the original brief before deciding effects. Deliver the page, actual rendered evidence and an honest visual assessment.

acceptance.driver_eligibility: Observed alternate runtime and actual installed driver rules; eligible Taste preferred for original marketing brief unless the user actually selected another driver; no exclusion based only on PATH or self-imposed effects.
acceptance.media_fit: Images/materials depict Hanoi convincingly at presentation size; a model is not considered superior merely for being3D; licensed sources and real assets have provenance.
acceptance.visual_brief: Blinded reviewer inspects phone/desktop against original audience/brief for composition, type, palette, subject identity and finish; technical or record pass is reported separately.
acceptance.interaction: Navigation/main travel action exercised; motion appropriate to the design and reduced-motion behavior observed; new page does not change existing app tokens.
acceptance.status_honesty: No visual pass from met:true alone; failed/unverified brief fit remains Needs review. If negative feedback is introduced after initial review, preserve it and require a new rendered assessment before completion.
